newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steadies as crude rises.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steadies as crude rises.

text.p: NWE low sulphur fuel oil steadied after recent falls as crude oil futures staged a late recovery, traders said.
One ARA player said he was offering some 25,000 tonnes, with flexible dates into late February, at $134 fob NWE. Dealers said the bid was somewhere around $131.
High sulphur straight-run fuel was steady to weaker alongside tumbling cracked values, although the recovery in crude futures helped stem the losses.
